## Accumulated Context

### Decisions

1. **Source fallback strategy** -- Beatconnect tested without auth token (D-02). 401 expected and documented as "NO (no token)" rather than connectivity failure.
2. **Config module pattern** -- All magic numbers centralized in config.py with __all__ export list and print_config() for notebook first-cell logging (I1).
3. **librosa.load for audio decoding** -- Used librosa.load (not torchaudio.load) in load_audio_from_osz for universal mp3/ogg/wav decoding. torchaudio still used for MelSpectrogram transform itself.
4. **Checkpoint pruning strategy** -- Keeps latest N + best N checkpoints, deletes all others and unmatched .pt files. Protects 20GB Kaggle Dataset limit.
5. **Shared peak-pick rule (v1.1)** -- peak_pick_frames() extracted public in baseline.py (Phase 5); baseline AND model AND JSON all route through it over min-max [0,1] envelopes. Resolves detect-normalize mismatch (P2).
6. **Gate vs PINNED baseline (v1.1)** -- EVL-04 gate compares against pinned Phase 0 important-bucket F, never per-run recompute.
7. **Toy gate = metronome only (v1.1)** -- Stage 1 gate uses generator_type="metronome_click" slices (10) only.
8. **ONNX version threshold 2.11 (v1.1)** -- ARCHITECTURE.md's >=2.14 gate outdated. Real dynamo threshold = 2.11 (PR #169710).
9. **v1.0 Phase 1 superseded (v1.1)** -- Coarse "Phase 1: Onset Head" replaced by Phases 5-10 breaking Stage 1 into hard-gated boundaries.
10. **Yardstick derivation = re-derive on search set (Phase 5, EVL-02)** -- Frozen params (delta=0.3) empirically degenerate on full songs: important-bucket F ~0.009. Decision: option b (librosa defaults delta=0.07, post_max=1, pre_avg=10, post_avg=11, wait=3) gives important-F ~0.272-0.320. Recorded in pin JSON.
11. **D-16: 5 eval songs + 1 search held-out** -- Local seed from 6 songs: 2561773 held out (38.1s, smallest) as search/calibration. Eval IDs: 2255671, 2256944, 2516285, 2527391, 2589624.

### Blockers/Concerns

1. **Kaggle PyTorch version (Phase 9)** -- ONNX dynamo path depends on actual torch.__version__ (>=2.11). Runtime version-check cell is prescribed resolution. Affects EXP-01.
2. **Salience-bucket FP semantics (Phase 8)** -- filter-refs-keep-ALL-ests recommended; must be decided in E2 plan so both sides symmetric. Affects EVL-03/04.
3. **Chunk-boundary label noise (Phase 8)** -- quantify boundary-fraction early; >5% -> pick mitigation. Affects EVL-03.
4. **Sliding-window normalization (Phase 10)** -- per-window renormalization distorts edges; window-consistent or overlap-sufficient merge decided in I3 plan. Affects PST-01.
5. **kagglehub cache staleness (Phase 8)** -- force-refresh + verify version matches run log on resume. Affects EXP-02.
